plivo is a command-line interface for the Plivo REST API.

Credentials resolve in order:
  1. --profile flag
  2. active profile in ~/.plivo/config.toml
  3. PLIVO_AUTH_ID / PLIVO_AUTH_TOKEN env vars

Usage:
  plivo [command]

Available Commands:
  account     Inspect and update the active Plivo account
  agent       Manage Plivo Vibe AI agents
  application Manage Plivo applications (voice/messaging webhooks)
  auth        Manage credentials and profiles
  brand       10DLC brand registration (US A2P 10-digit-long-code messaging)
  call        Make and inspect voice calls
  campaign    10DLC campaign registration (use cases for a brand)
  cnam        Caller-ID Name (CNAM) lookup for a US/CA number (spends money — requires --yes)
  compliance  Manage compliance documents (KYC, business proofs)
  conference  Inspect and control live audio conferences
  contacto    Manage Contacto session (used by `plivo agent` for AI agent CRUD)
  endpoint    Manage SIP endpoints (registered SIP devices/usernames)
  link        10DLC number-to-campaign linking
  lookup      Carrier + format lookup for an E.164 number (lookup.plivo.com)
  masking     Number-Masking sessions (privacy-preserving call/SMS bridge)
  message     Send and inspect SMS/MMS messages
  mpc         Multi-Party Calls (MPC) — group voice rooms with dynamic participants
  number      Manage account phone numbers
  powerpack   Powerpacks — number pools for high-volume SMS
  recording   List, fetch, and delete call/conference recordings
  stream      Live audio streams on a call (WebSocket bridge for transcription / agents)
  subaccount  Manage subaccounts under the master account
  tollfree    Toll-free verification (US TFN messaging compliance)
  verify      Plivo Verify — OTP / phone-number verification sessions

Flags:
      --all                        auto-paginate through all pages
      --dry-run                    print the HTTP request without sending
      --explain                    explain what the command will do before executing
      --hodor-server plivo agent   base URL for hodor (used by plivo agent and `plivo auth token`)
      --log-level string           log level: debug|info|warn|error|none (default "warn")
      --no-color                   disable colored output
  -o, --output string              output format: table|json (default: table for TTY, json otherwise)
      --profile string             named profile from ~/.plivo/config.toml
  -q, --quiet                      suppress non-data output
      --timeout int                request timeout in seconds (default 30)
  -y, --yes                        skip confirmation prompts

Use "plivo [command] --help" for more information about a command.
